svg.title: 1. EKS platform: reference architecture
svg.text: Platform VPC 10.40.0.0/16 (routable, from IPAM) + 100.64.0.0/16 (secondary CIDR, pods only)
Payments EKS cluster, PCI account (hard tenancy)
own VPC, own nodes, reached only through VPC Lattice
Shared EKS platform for 38 product teams (prod, eu-west-1): one cluster, many tenants, Karpenter, custom networking
Every namespace gets, from one Git manifest:
an access entry scoped to the namespace,
Pod Identity associations per service account,
and a cost label for split cost allocation.
~120 nodes / 3,500 pods on a normal day
Node primary IPs, load balancer ENIs,
Pods only, via ENIConfig per AZ, /28 prefixes.
49,137 usable. SNAT to the node IP leaving the VPC.
